search.title: Doge (meme)
search.snippet: Doge is an Internet meme that became popular in 2013. The meme typically consists of a picture of a Shiba Inu dog accompanied by multicolored text in Comic Sans.

search.title: Dogecoin
search.snippet: Dogecoin is a cryptocurrency created by Billy Markus and Jackson Palmer in December 2013, based on the Doge meme.

search.title: Kabosu (dog)
search.snippet: Kabosu was a Japanese Shiba Inu whose 2010 photograph became the Doge meme.
